capture_contract.captured_state: Actual PUSHFD/PUSHAD image: EDI,ESI,EBP,savedESP,EBX,EDX,ECX,EAX,EFLAGS. No register is zeroed or added as an invented logical input.
capture_contract.original_stack: Modeled instructions keep the original entry ESP and actual caller argument/local addresses, so native stack aliases and parent EBP remain available. Only the C control stack is separated.
capture_contract.control_stack: The canonical entry advances one page at a time below the64KB native workspace using paired register/flags-neutral XCHGs, restoring each touched DWORD. PUSHFD/PUSHAD capture occurs only below that workspace; savedESP is adjusted to the real original anchor. No initial native local is replaced by the snapshot. C executes below the snapshot; deeper frames and asynchronous/fault/unwind context remain qualified.
capture_contract.restore: Existing C providers update the snapshot; original physical ESP and per-entry RETn are restored without changing the modeled flags. POPAD intentionally ignores its savedESP slot.
capture_contract.named_API: Named snapshot calls require a separate physical C control stack, a real savedESP+4 native entry anchor, initialized original return/argument slots and a snapshot outside the borrowed workspace.
